name: NFT Paradise
seoDescription: Explore NFT Paradise codes to get free stars for opening rare NFT crates and boosting your collection in Roblox’s NFT Paradise game.
introMd: NFT Paradise is a Roblox game where you open NFT crates to collect rare items and earn stars. Stars are key because they let you unlock better crates and climb the leaderboards. Codes in NFT Paradise give you free stars, which can save you a lot of grinding. Knowing how to use these codes can really boost your collection and gameplay experience without spending extra time farming stars.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem NFT Paradise Codes
You don’t need any special level or requirements to redeem codes in NFT Paradise. Just follow these simple steps:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch NFT Paradise]] on Roblox.
2. Click your username at the top right corner.
3. Find the Promocode box and type in the active code.
4. Click Redeem to get your stars instantly.
Redeeming codes is quick and gives you a direct boost to open more crates.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Redeeming codes in NFT Paradise mainly gives you stars, the in-game currency needed to open NFT crates. Here’s what you get:

| Reward Type | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| Stars       | Used to open NFT crates and unlock rare NFTs. More stars mean more chances for high-rarity items.

Stars are the core reward because they let you access better loot crates and improve your NFT collection faster.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes might fail if they have expired or if there’s a typo when entering them. Always check for exact spelling and capitalization. Also, some codes only work once per account, so trying to redeem the same code again won’t work.
findCodesMd:
## Where to Find New NFT Paradise Codes
The developer often shares new codes on the official NFT Paradise Discord server, especially in the #update-log channel. This is the best place to catch fresh codes as soon as they drop. You can also check the developer’s socials listed below for announcements and code releases.
